stay.nearest_base: Mukkali (park gateway; Kerala Forest Department guest house and dormitory, advance booking only, no current tariff found), Mannarkkad, or Agali Hills (about 20 km, private lodges)
stay.notes: Wikivoyage (https://en.wikivoyage.org/wiki/Silent_Valley_National_Park): 'Tourists are not allowed to stay overnight at the valley; they have to return to Mukkali by evening'; the forest department has a guest house and dormitory at Mukkali, rooms booked in advance, and more lodges are at Agali Hills, 20 km; visitors can also stay at Mannarkkad and hire a jeep to reach Mukkali by 8 AM. The only printed forest guest house tariff found is Outlook Traveller, 16 Jul 2017 (https://site.outlookindia.com/traveller/ot-getaway-guides/silent-valley-national-park/): guest house 1,000 and dormitory 150 per person per day, too old and then under renovation to publish. Mannarkkad and Agali prices were not researched because they are other towns.

point_to_point.route: Silent Valley National Park safari jeep (vehicle charge per jeep, max 5 people)

taxi_day.basis: Kerala Tourism page for Silent Valley National Park: 'The vehicle charges are Rs. 1600 per jeep that takes a maximum of 5 people'; entry Rs 50 per person; guide INR 150. Page undated. Private vehicles are not allowed into the core area, so there is no local taxi day.
taxi_day.notes: This is the park's own jeep fee, not a Mannarkkad or Mukkali taxi fare. A third-party site quotes about 2,000 for a 5-seater jeep (Sept 2026); not used.

food_per_person_day.basis: No restaurant page for Mukkali or Silent Valley found. Wikivoyage/Outlook say the forest guest house serves no food and visitors eat at nearby teashops.

unverified: current forest guest house and dormitory tariff at Mukkali
